name: KKR & Co. Inc.
monetization: Private-equity and infrastructure manager; monetizes AI through data-center platform ownership (CyrusOne, Nxera/STT GDC in APAC) and, via Nvidia's coalition, compute-collateralized customer financing.
description_md: KKR is a global private-equity, infrastructure, and credit manager whose AI exposure runs through data-center platforms: it took CyrusOne private with GIP for ~$15B in 2022 (then the largest data-center deal ever) and has built an APAC footprint around Singtel's Nxera and ST Telemedia Global Data Centres.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: own hyperscale landlords through the demand super-cycle. CyrusOne has become a major AI-era hyperscale developer under KKR/GIP ownership; in APAC, KKR bought ~20% of Singtel's regional data-center arm (Nxera) and, with Singtel, agreed to acquire the remaining stake in ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (~$6.6B), consolidating a 100-facility, 1GW+ pipeline platform. In Aug 2026 KKR joined Nvidia's >$500B compute-collateralized customer-financing coalition (subject to final agreements), adding a credit leg to its landlord positions.
risk_notes_md: Platform-level leverage on CyrusOne and the APAC vehicles is not fully public; single-tenant hyperscale developments concentrate counterparty risk in a handful of AI buyers. Coalition participation would correlate KKR's credit book with the same compute demand that underwrites its data-center rents.
